ideas.pitch: An edge-AI navigation system integrating lightweight depth cameras to automatically steer the hovercraft through racing checkpoints without manual control.
ideas.problem_statement: Hovercraft Design, Racing Rounds, and Autonomy Bonus: Integrate autonomous navigation for extra points by successfully navigating checkpoints or entire track sections without manual control.
ideas.title: AeroGuard AI: Autonomous Obstacle-Dodging Hovercraft
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Autonomy Bonus directly addresses the scoring system where points are awarded for track navigation and time taken, capturing crucial bonus multipliers that standard manual drivers will miss.

ideas.pitch: A dual-mode sensor-guided tactical hovercraft equipped with perimeter distance sensors to autonomously detect and push opponents out of the knockout arena while maintaining boundary self-awareness.
ideas.problem_statement: Match Rules: In knockout rounds, teams must push opponents off the arena, with penalties for inactivity, while leveraging autonomy bonuses.
ideas.title: VectorPush: Autonomous Knockout Aggressor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical defense with automated counter-attacks, giving teams an edge in knockout elimination rounds where inactivity penalties are heavily penalized.

ideas.pitch: A compact onboard telemetry unit that monitors battery discharge, motor temperature, and lift height dynamically during racing runs to optimize power delivery.
ideas.problem_statement: Scoring System: Racing points are awarded based on successful track navigation, obstacle avoidance, and time taken, where maximum efficiency determines victory.
ideas.title: HoverTelemetry: Real-Time Motor and Lift Performance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in hardware-heavy engineering competitions reward precise data-driven tuning that prevents motor burnout and maximizes thrust-to-weight efficiency.

ideas.pitch: A high-frequency floor-facing optical flow and IR sensor array designed to keep the hovercraft locked to the racing circuit line even at maximum throttle.
ideas.problem_statement: Racing rounds: Teams must follow the track, avoiding penalties for obstacles, human intervention, or deviating from the path.
ideas.title: LineMaster: High-Speed Optical Track Tracker for Hovercrafts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes time penalties caused by human steering lag and track deviation, directly improving the final score calculation of Total Points minus Time Taken.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic speed-profiling tool that pre-programs thrust vectors for known track layouts to balance high-speed straightaways with tight cornering.
ideas.problem_statement: Scoring System: Racing points are awarded based on successful track navigation, obstacle avoidance, and time taken, with final scores calculated as Total Points minus Time Taken.
ideas.title: ThrustOpt: Dynamic Vectoring and Speed Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mathematical approach to minimizing the time variable in the final score equation, providing a competitive edge over purely reactive manual driving.
